item.title: Toyota Sports 800 (1965)
item.description:
Publication: Motor Fan
Format: Road Test
Date: June 1965
Authors (Roundtable): Tatsuo Hasegawa, Shozo Sato, Kazuo Kumabe, Osamu Hirao, Mineo Yamamoto, Masatoshi Yoshida, Yasuhei Oguchi, Atsushi Watari, Kenji Higuchi, Taizo Tateishi, Masahi Kondo, Kenzaburo Ishikawa, Tenji Kobayashi, Motor Fan Editorial Staff (uncredited)

Even Though It is Small…

Magazine: With the release of the Toyota Sports 800, Toyota has finally entered the sports car segment. Could you please explain the aims and thinking that went into designing this car?
